Community pool

Gas grill

Electric fireplace

4 bikes!

Explore Seaside, WaterColor, Seagrove, Alys and Rosemary Beach

4-star restaurants

Boutiques

Coral Reef by Oversee 30A | Perfect in Walton County Awards – Three-Time Diamond Winner – Best Rental Mgmt. 2026, 2025, 2024 Welcome! Coral Reef is on the south side of 30A, just steps from the beautiful beaches, in the gated Seashore Village community of Seagrove Beach. This 3-story, 6-bedroom home is sure to be a delight for the whole family. It’s available for a few days, a week, or extend your stay for a month (or more). Just a short, easy walk from the home is your own private beach. The crystal-clear water is complimentary, as are the beach chairs with umbrella, from March thru October.

These will be set up for you to enjoy daily. Very nice service. Need immediate comfort? Hop into the gated pool. It’s privately owned and shared by our other two houses, Dolphin Run, and Seashell Castle. With brand-new lounge chairs and Adirondack chairs, sit back, keep an eye on the kids, and relax in comfort. Rested? Then jump on one of the complimentary bikes and go check out the local scene. Inside, the second and third-floor decks have stunning views of the gulf. The 50” fireplace creates heat and ambience. The second-floor deck extends the length of the house from the primary suite, king, to the guest room, queen. Ever wake up to a Gulf breeze, and the smell of the salt air? Divine. Welcome! Our dedicated team at Oversee 30A, a local company, is committed to ensuring your stay is nothing short of exceptional. We strive for perfection and are just a stone's throw away should you require any assistance. Reach out to us anytime, seven days a week, with the added peace of a 24/7 emergency line. If you still need more room, our other two (2) beach houses are just next door. -Seashell Castle (VRBO# 1881032) -Dolphin Run (VRBO# 1883886) Overview: - Complimentary beach chairs and an umbrella (March 1st - October 31st) - 6 Bedrooms, 3.5 Bathrooms - 2,064 sq ft - Private beach access - Community pool - 4 complimentary bikes - Wi-Fi - Gas grill - Private off-street gated parking - Electric fireplace Overnight: - King in guest room on 1st floor; shared full hall bath - Sleeper sofa, queen, in 1st floor living room - King in 2nd story primary; attached balcony and private bath - Queen in 2nd story guest room; shared hallway bath; attached balcony - 2 twins in 2nd story guest room; shared hallway bath - Twin over full bunks in 3rd floor guest room; shared hallway half bath - Twin daybed with trundle in 3rd floor guest room; shared hallway half bath Check-in is 4:00 PM CST. Check-out is 10:00 AM CST.
